faq.lede: If a fifteen-year-old cannot follow the answer, the answer is wrong. Here are the short ones.
faq.a1: A media company. We advertise. We do not sell a product and we do not process payments.
faq.a2: Read. Talk to Iris, our helper. Give a research gift if you want. You do not need an account to look.
faq.a3: No. She is not a doctor, a lawyer, or a bank. She is a helper on this site. If you need care, call a real clinic.
faq.q4: Is Fuel a coin or a stock?
faq.a4: No. Fuel is prepaid minutes for our tools, like putting money on a transit card. What you do not use stays yours. It is not a share. It is not investment advice.
faq.a5: No. Looking is free. Talking to Iris is free. Giving is optional. Buying minutes is optional.
faq.q6: What if the number is wrong?
faq.a6: Then you owe nothing. If we cannot show the same figure again, the deal does not stand. That is the house rule.
faq.a7: Yes. Close the tab. Walk away. We are only useful if you choose to use us.
